What we do

The yard, the walk, the roof.

From a new fire pit to a full roof replacement, we handle the outside of your home. Call for a free quote on any of these.

  1. Paver patios & walkways

    Hardscape

    Patios, front walks and entries laid on a compacted base, with contrasting borders and edging.

  2. Fire pits & seating walls

    Hardscape

    Round or square fire pits, curved seating walls and raised patios with block walls.

  3. Stamped & poured concrete

    Concrete

    Stamped patios, curved walkways and plain poured slabs.

  4. Steps

    Concrete & pavers

    Rebuilt concrete steps and rounded paver steps off patio doors.

  5. Lawn care & garden beds

    Landscaping

    Ongoing lawn service and garden beds planted and mulched.

  6. New-build yards

    Landscaping

    Rough lots graded, then strawed and seeded so the lawn can come in.

  7. Snow removal

    Winter

    Driveways and sidewalks kept clear and safe through the winter.

  8. Roofing

    Roofs

    Shingle roof replacements for houses and multi-family buildings.
